## Description

Implements step 6 of `deal-shape-chain` (alliance_post_launch_review) and step 2 of `jv-lifecycle-governance` (jv_health_scorecard): the per-partnership health scorecard across the seven JV dimensions, and the dated post-launch review of an alliance against its selection rationale. Does not cover partner sourcing (partner-sourcing-strategy), partner screening (partner-due-diligence) or JV structuring (jv-structuring). Use when: "partnership health scorecard", "alliance post-launch review", "JV health review", "partnership monitoring".
